title: Blockchain anchor
description: A canonical record binding one verdict journal head to one public blockchain transaction. It is a timestamping commitment, not evidence that the journaled claims are true and not, by itself, protection against an attacker who controls the repository and the anchoring pipeline.

journal_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact journal bytes anchored by the transaction.

journal_head.description: Hash of the last journal entry.

network.description: Chain-specific network, for example mainnet, testnet3, testnet4 or sepolia.

block_height.description: Block containing the transaction, when known.

block_hash.description: Hash of the block containing the transaction, when known.

confirmations.description: Confirmations observed when the record was created.

inclusion_proof.description: Provider-specific merkle or receipt proof. Its semantics are declared by provider, so this schema only preserves its bytes.

provider.description: Name of the wallet, node or service used to publish the commitment.

provider_output_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the provider's raw JSON output at publication time.

anchored_at.description: ISO 8601 publication or observation time with an offset.
